correctness.rationale: Correct stationary covariance: V(U)=1/2[1+(epsilon^-1-1)U_1^2], and fixed-lag autocorrelation is the exact variance-weighted combination of e^-epsilon*t and e^-t. A Haar squared coordinate is Beta(1/2,(n-1)/2); Gaussian representation U_1^2=G_1^2/S_n and simultaneous concentration of S_n/n over polynomial m_n reduces the maximal projection to the maximum of independent chi-square_1 variables. The Gaussian-square Mills tail gives m_n P(chi²_1>b_m+2x)->e^-x, Poisson exceedances and Gumbel; rational transforms of the same maximum give the 3 regimes of Vmax and autocorrelation. Conditions m_n=floor(n^kappa), kappa>0, epsilon>0, fixed t, epsilon possibly tending to zero, and exact strict slow-contribution dominance W>epsilon/(1+epsilon) are respected. Finite sensor diagnostics are not used as asymptotic proof.
